Chief Economic Adviser suggests E10 fuel option for older vehicles

Chief Economic Adviser V. Anantha Nageswaran has recommended restoring the E10 fuel option at petrol pumps for older vehicles. He argued for its reintroduction, suggesting it would benefit owners of vehicles not designed for higher ethanol blends. However, officials have stated that the government is not currently considering reintroducing E10, citing logistical challenges and the necessity of the current E20 blend.
